frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original genus-level whole organism. Choose better-known Q.lawsoni; retain long straight neck, huge pointed beak, tall walking limbs, folded wings. Not isolated skull or giant Q.northropi.
frozen_scientific_scope.specimen_basis: TMM41961-1 holotype includes partial skull, cervicals and limb elements, not complete skeleton. Andres/Langston2021 Fig1B combines holotype/referred/inferred bones, explicitly colour-coded; UT skull image is a cast with sculpted missing areas.

scale.basis: Andres/Langston2021 p47 and diagnosis; species estimate not pose bounding-box width. Reject mixing10m Q.northropi or18–20ft press number.
scale.constructed_path_note: Approximate straightened sum of shoulder-to-wrist plus single fourth-finger control-path lengths and 0.28 m shoulder spacing. Close to 4.5 m reference, not a fossil measurement or folded bounding box.

uncertainties: Soft tissue, membrane attachment/outline, skin colour and static pose are inferred.
Do not reproduce bone openings as holes in living flesh.
Folded pose height/length are artistic proportions, not measured holotype;4.5m is unfolded span reference.
